reviews.title: Native, please.
reviews.text: Your usage of non-standard UI components was always terrible, but on iPhone Duo, your app is horribly out of date. reviews.title: Poor options for basic things

Downloads only work on Wi-Fi with no option to use cellular, and you can't pick the quality, so it's stuck at 720p. Every other streaming app lets you choose both. Wouldn't have paid for Premium if I'd known. Please add a cellular download option and quality settings.

reviews.title: How is this still a problem?
reviews.text:
Can never remember my timestamp when i go to click on the history, every single time now the app loses my place in the video when i click off and watch later thru history. Not to mention its still god awful having to operate the video bar on mobile, i mean it is insulting how bad trying to scrub thru a video is. Oh and when streams end, you will lose your place - good luck finding it again. Hope you remembered because rumble didnt even try. 

Whats the point of owning a video player if its most basic functions have been broken for over a year? How is it possible this is still a problem? What do your devs do all day? Have you people ever once used this app? How much money is being wasted on a developer team that cant do something thats been a mainstay on the internet for thirty years?

There is only one streamer left that i watch on here, i pray he gets his own platform or a deal somewhere else because i will never spend any more time than is absolutely necessary on this godforsaken app. This is like my third review trying to get this fixed, sad.

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text: I genuinely cannot explore a creators videos because the design of the app is so buggy and poorly designed it prohibits me. Firstly, there is no option to sort uploads by release date, views etc, you have to scroll through every single video a creator makes from the very top each time you want to explore their channel, so you’re forced to swipe the screen over and over like an idiot to get to videos years old. Terrible design really stupid. But you can’t even do that, because the further you scroll the app starts to lag to the point where, once you’ve scrolled past a few hundred videos, the app drops to about a frame per second and it’s unusable. It’s infuriating. You need to use some sort of lazy loading scrolling system so that it’s not holding every single item in memory the further you scroll down. How did you not test this before release? Especially since there’s no other way to explore old videos than to scroll far down. Ridiculous

reviews.title: For the love of god…
reviews.text: Rumble…… I love what you stand for. Your ethos. Your values. But for the love of god, man: FIX THIS APP. Most of the shows I watch occur during my working hours. I would love to listen to them, but it’s basically entirely impossible. If I get a phone call, if I pause the show, if I walk away from the WiFi I’m on, if I turn my phone screen off, sometimes for no reason at all….. the video will drop and buffer for all eternity. I have to quit the app. Find my show. Try to find where I was. I’ll finally find where I left off and it works, for about 2 minutes. Then it stalls again and I have to waste 5 minutes trying to find my place again. Now I’ve lost 20 minutes of the livestream and the show has ended, so I can’t watch for another few hours. I don’t have the luxury to sit in front of my desktop computer screen to watch everything live with zero interruptions—please make this app work as well as YT.
